Da Vinci/Voice options

Finding Da Vinci’s voice

Round four: last round’s Option 6 (Charon) is the anchor — kept unchanged as the reference, then pushed toward a noticeably more refined British delivery. Option 2 is the same voice with a stronger Received Pronunciation read at the same pace; options 3–6 take the strongest accent read at a brisker, more efficient pace. Same paragraph throughout, so they compare fairly.

The audition script

“Good morning, Ross. Revenue is up 12 percent this week — 128 thousand dollars across 1,284 orders. Your Spring Style Refresh campaign is performing well, with a 42 percent open rate so far. One thing needs your attention: eleven orders are waiting on fulfillment because the Aurora Trail Jacket is low on stock. I’ve already drafted a restock request with your supplier, and queued a back-in-stock email for the 86 customers on the waitlist. Just say the word, and I’ll send both.”
